title: how to convert AST to css and css to AST ?
fixedBy: bda77f3 'Add support for StyleSheet visitor function' (v1.23.0, 2024-01-14) for AST->CSS of a whole sheet; raw return values (since 1.19.0 in the repro range) for CSS->node
impact: 4 reactions. A non-maintainer replied in 2026-06 with a mostly correct answer (raw values; transform a snippet), but it says there is no JS AST->CSS path, missing the StyleSheet-visitor return trick.
code: node/index.d.ts: Visitor.StyleSheet return value, ReturnedDeclaration {property, raw}, RawValue {raw}
summary: No dedicated toCss()/parse() JS exports exist, but both directions work: CSS->AST via the StyleSheet visitor; AST->CSS by returning an AST from a StyleSheet visitor on an empty input (whole sheet) or by putting a captured node into a placeholder rule; and a CSS string can be put into the tree with {property, raw} / {raw}. Not a strictly lossless round trip: output is normalized (e.g. `(min-width:10px)` prints as `(width>=10px)` with no targets).
repro: 556-repro.mjs: roundtrip '.a{color:red;margin:1px 2px}@media (min-width:10px){.b{width:1px}}' -> '.a{color:red;margin:1px 2px}@media (width>=10px){.b{width:1px}}'; a captured `border` Declaration printed via a placeholder rule -> 'border: 1px solid red'; {property:'color', raw:'rgb(255 0 0)'} -> 'color: red'. Correct on local, 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1.
evidence: repro.mjs --range 1.18.0..1.33.0: roundtrip-stylesheet correct from 1.23.0 (1.22.1 prints empty: StyleSheet visitor ignored); raw declaration return correct from 1.19.0; single-declaration printing correct throughout the range.

fix.approach: Optional: document the StyleSheet visitor (and printing a returned AST) in website/pages/transforms.md. A first-class `print(ast)`/`printNode` export would be a small napi feature if the maintainer wants it; not needed to answer this.

notVerified: Printing individual non-declaration nodes (selectors, media queries) through placeholder rules was not tested.
